tools.name: fenofin_api_key_status
tools.description: Show the API key's environment (live or sandbox), its scopes, whether it may write, and when it expires. Call it first to learn which tools the key can use. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/status/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_administraties
tools.description: List the FenoFin administraties (bookkeeping files) this API key can reach, with basic company data. Use the returned id in the other tools. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/.

tools.name: fenofin_get_administratie
tools.description: Get one administratie: company name, legal form, KvK number, VAT id, place and whether it is a sandbox file. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_boekjaren
tools.description: List the financial years (boekjaren) of an administratie. Use a boekjaar id in fenofin_get_saldibalans. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/boekjaren/.

tools.name: fenofin_get_saldibalans
tools.description: Get the trial balance (saldibalans) of one financial year: debit and credit totals, result and one line per ledger account. Optional period dates must fall inside the year. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/boekjaren/{boekjaar_id}/saldibalans/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_grootboekrekeningen
tools.description: List the ledger accounts (chart of accounts) of an administratie. Set actief to true for active accounts only. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/grootboekrekeningen/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_btw_codes
tools.description: List the VAT codes of an administratie, optionally valid on a given date. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/btw-codes/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_afnemers
tools.description: List the customers (debtors, afnemers) of an administratie. Use gewijzigd_na for a delta sync. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/afnemers/.

tools.name: fenofin_get_afnemer
tools.description: Get one customer: contact data, VAT and KvK numbers, and payment settings. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/afnemers/{afnemer_id}/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_leveranciers
tools.description: List the suppliers (creditors, leveranciers) of an administratie. Use gewijzigd_na for a delta sync. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/leveranciers/.

tools.name: fenofin_get_leverancier
tools.description: Get one supplier: contact data, VAT and KvK numbers, and payment settings. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/leveranciers/{leverancier_id}/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_verkoopfacturen
tools.description: List sales invoices, with status (Concept, Openstaand, Deels Betaald, Betaald, Teveel Betaald), totals and paid parts. Filter by status or project_id. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/verkoopfacturen/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_inkoopfacturen
tools.description: List purchase invoices (supplier bills) of an administratie. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/inkoopfacturen/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_producten
tools.description: List the active sales products of an administratie, with their product ids. Use a product id in fenofin_create_concept_invoice. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/producten/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_kasboeken
tools.description: List the cash books (kasboeken) of an administratie. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/kasboeken/.

tools.name: fenofin_list_projecten
tools.description: List projects with their customer, status (concept, actief, afgerond), fixed price (aanneemsom), invoiced and remaining amounts. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/projecten/.

tools.name: fenofin_get_project
tools.description: Get one project: customer, status, dates, fixed price, team and the invoiced and remaining amounts. FenoFin API: GET /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/projecten/{project_id}/.

tools.name: fenofin_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer (debtor) in an administratie. Writes data to the books. Pass a new idempotency_key per record and the same key when you retry. FenoFin API: POST /api/v1/administraties/{administratie_id}/afnemers/.

tools.name: fenofin_create_concept_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft (Concept) sales invoice for a customer. FenoFin does not number or send a draft; making it final is a separate step that this server does not offer. Writes data to the books. Pass a new idempotency_key per record and the same key when you retry. FenoFin API: POST /api/v1/administratie
